title: Google LSA for Window and Door Companies
html:
Local Services Ads Management for Window and Door Companies

Local services ads management for window and door companies starts with whether Google will show your jobs at all. Then it moves to the profile, the leads and the budget.

Eligibility and job types

Google lists the job types you can sell through LSA, and the list differs by city.

  • License and insurance proof
  • Background check steps
  • Job type selection
  • City availability check

Lead vetting and disputes

Every lead is sorted into repair, replacement, wrong service or out of area.

  • Repair or replacement tags
  • Lead feedback reports
  • Zip code tightening
  • Lead outcome notes

Budget and bids

If one zip code costs more per booked job than the next, budget moves.

  • Budget per service area
  • Pay-per-lead goal
  • Spend tracking
  • Shifts by zip code

Lead tracking and booked jobs

Reports show cost per booked estimate, because ten leads that never book cost more than three that do.

  • Outcome tag per lead
  • Cost per booked estimate
  • Answer rate review
  • Plain-language reports

How We Run LSA for Window and Door Companies

The process runs in four steps, and the first one decides whether LSA is worth starting. Google's verification timing sets the real launch date.

Optimize

Review requests go out after each finished install so the profile gets stronger as jobs close.

Report and Decide

You get a report in booked estimates and cost per booked estimate.

LSA for Window and Door Companies vs Google Ads

LSA sells you a lead, and Google Ads sells you a click. LSA suits homeowners ready to call, while Google Ads gives you more control over keywords and landing pages. Some companies run both.

Is LSA Right for Your Window or Door Company?

LSA is right for you when someone answers your phone and Google lists your jobs in your city. If either is missing, fix that first or start with Google Ads.

Start now if

  • You are licensed and insured where you work
  • You can list the zip codes you serve
  • Someone answers calls during your listed hours
  • You want replacement jobs and can quote them fast

Wait if

  • Your jobs are missing from Google's picker for your city
  • No one can answer or return calls quickly
  • Your profile has few reviews and no install photos
  • Your calendar cannot take more estimates this month

FAQs About Google LSA for Window and Door Companies

Answers to common questions window and door owners have before they start Local Services Ads. Topics run from setup and eligibility to lead quality and lead volume.

How do I set up Google Local Services Ads?

Start at Google's Local Services Ads signup, pick your business category and job types, and add your service area. Google then runs verification, which can include license, insurance and background checks. Ads go live after approval.

Who can use Google Local Services Ads?

Only businesses in categories Google supports, in cities where LSA is available, that pass Google's checks.

How do Google Local Services Ads work?

Google shows your business on Search and Maps with your phone number, and you pay per valid lead, not per click. Google is moving these campaigns into Google Ads as Performance Max with pay-per-lead goals, and the pay-per-lead model stays.
